disposition_reason: Table 5 prints detection counts, means and ranges for eight elements in 44 retail blue cheeses; cobalt, nickel, copper and arsenic were not detected.

study.design: Retail survey of blue-veined cheeses for mycotoxins, biogenic amines and 13 elements with exposure assessment
study.origin: Latvia (3), Denmark (7), England (3), France (9), Germany (2), Italy (11), Lithuania (2), Poland (7), Spain (2)
study.market: Supermarkets and gourmet stores in Riga, Latvia
study.lod_text: LOD 3x SD of blanks, LOQ 10x SD; per-element values in supplementary Table S3 (not available); Cd detected at the LOD level 0.002 mg/kg
study.qa: Daily QC solutions 2 and 50 µg/L; recoveries < 120%, RSD < 20% (Table S3); interlaboratory control reference materials for uncertainty
